content: MuJoCo object pose extraction: sim.data.body_xpos[sim.model.body_name2id('bowl_1')] for world-frame position (3,); sim.data.body_xmat for rotation (9,). Camera intrinsics: robosuite camera_utils.get_camera_intrinsic_matrix(sim, cam_name, H, W). Camera extrinsics: sim.data.cam_xpos[cam_id], sim.data.cam_xmat[cam_id]. Depth: set camera_depths=True, obs['agentview_depth'] returns float meters (H,W,1). Backproject with intrinsics to get 3D point cloud. Segmentation: camera_segmentations='instance' in OffScreenRenderEnv.
